heroTagline: A private, offline-first personal finance tracker. No account, no cloud, no server — your data never leaves your device.

features.title: Net worth over time
features.body: Monthly snapshots of every account, with month-over-month and financial-year trends.

features.title: Per-account growth trend
features.body: View the growth trend of each account over time, not just your total — see exactly which holdings are moving.

features.title: Excel in, Excel out
features.body: Import your existing spreadsheet and export back to it. Excel stays the source of truth you own.

features.title: Tax helper
features.body: Import official ITR JSON exports and get an advisory ITR-form recommendation.

features.title: Goals & projections
features.body: Set targets and see realistic ETAs based on your actual saving pace.

features.title: FIRE calculator
features.body: Project your path to Financial Independence / Retire Early — target corpus, safe withdrawal, and the age you get there.

features.title: Encrypted vault
features.body: Account credentials protected by a master password (Argon2id + Stronghold). No plain text, ever.

features.title: Emergency & estate planning
features.body: Size your emergency fund against real expenses, and keep nominee and estate details organised for the people who'll need them.

features.title: Sync over your own LAN
features.body: Sync between desktop and mobile directly over your own Wi-Fi — nothing is ever shared over the internet.

privacyNote.title: No backend. No telemetry.
privacyNote.body: All data lives in a local SQLite database and an encrypted vault on your own machine. myFinance can't phone home — there's nowhere for it to call.
